Name: Matching Seasonal Wizard Portrait
Author: Arillume
Description:
This mod adds a closer matching wizard portrait for his sprite.

The mod is meant for Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter for SVE, however there will most likely be options for vanilla and non-seasonal SVE in the future.

(will add ears in a future update as an option)

You need to manually put the assets folder into the Seasonal Outfits folder, there are instructions in the replacement folder. Let me know if you need additional instructions for installation and I will try my best :)

Downloads.Description: first version, contains wizard and magnus portrait sheets. no code.
